Source_alias_and_failure_limits: No null, membership, underflow, saturation, or concurrency guard is present.
No entry count-zero guard: zero/one/negative count with zero link tests enters mutation.
No allocation/free/lock/virtual-profile/slot lookup/callback/loop/CALL/tail transfer is present.
The first splice can alter current next/previous; preserve the reload at00874E88 and the later previous load.
Clear next at+0C before previous at+08; either can alter an aliased list count before its read/modify/write.
The conditional PUSH may itself alter aliased list/node backing used by later reads.
Field writes can overwrite saved EDI, return-address, or argument-stack memory. Balanced instruction deltas do not prove intact control-stack contents.
No owned exception frame/handler or hardware-fault recovery is present; a later access fault need not undo earlier writes.
Static byte/CFG/flag reasoning does not establish valid memory, caller return use, race behavior, or execution equivalence.
